style: Rakaza, a cheerful anime VTuber girl with a short violet-indigo bob haircut with hot-pink rim light, large violet eyes, a soft warm smile, a purple gaming headset and a dark indigo tech jacket with pink trim. Flat vector-like illustration, clean thick outlines, deep indigo background with an electric violet sunburst and halftone dots, mustard-yellow four-point sparkles, hot pink and mint accents. Square meme composition with empty space at the top and bottom. No text, no letters, no watermark.
